main.summary:
Backend engineer with {{CAREER_DURATION}} of experience across 4 domains (Education, Healthcare, Clinical Trials, Gaming), leading 10+ projects and achieving quantifiable results including 82% BigQuery cost reduction, CDK-based analytics infrastructure as code, and building an internal NPM package ecosystem.

Specialized in system design from monolithic to Event-Driven serverless architectures, creating long-term business value through GCP-AWS hybrid data pipeline construction and root cause analysis.

items: Cloud Cost Optimization: 82% BigQuery cost reduction via Storage Read API ($6.25→$1.1 per TB)
CDK-based Infrastructure as Code: Built Kinesis → Firehose → S3 → Glue → Athena analytics pipeline as IaC
Serverless Performance Tuning: Lambda ARM64 migration 20% cost reduction, Meta asset sync 72% faster
Event-Driven Architecture: SQS + Lambda + EventBridge async processing expanding data collection 6x
Internal NPM Package Ecosystem: 10 NestJS utility modules + Game Server Kit packages ensuring multi-project code consistency
GCP-AWS Hybrid Pipeline: Pub/Sub → Cloud Function → API Gateway → Lambda cross-cloud real-time data integration
Incident Analysis & Resolution: Complete Deadlock resolution through foreign key lock timing analysis in clinical trials
Data Consistency: Transactional Outbox pattern + distributed locks ensuring event consistency
Probability Audit Log: DynamicModule-based probability package integrated across 12 game projects with 94%+ test coverage
